lines.trans: Come on, Uncle Grisha, we did a fine job.
Did you hear what she said? 'I'm not afraid of you!'
And people are supposed to be afraid of us! Nobody is afraid of us!
She is afraid, I saw it.
We've been working for a week already! And nobody has given us any money.
And why is all that? Because you're a coward!
And what should I do?
We agreed: I scare them, and you illustrate!
I was illustrating! I was making a scary face!
You can make a scary face at your wife! Here you have to take action!
And what should I have done?
Anything at all! You could have broken a wardrobe.
Then they'll understand that we are serious people.
Then let's go, let's go back! I'll turn everything upside down!
No! Right now we'll go have lunch.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

действовать.gloss: to act, to take action; to work

meanings.en: to act, to take action, to get to work
to work, to be in effect
meanings.note: правило действует = the rule is in force

examples.trans: Come on, Danya, go. Get to work!

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
masculine, but declined like a feminine noun in -я
colloquial, as children say; дяди из Москвы = some people from Moscow
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: I'm with my wife this evening.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: to illustrate (a book, or a point with actions)

examples.text: Мы же договорились: я пугаю, а ты иллюстрируешь!

He has a very kind face.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
неделю = for a week; через неделю = in a week
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.

отработать.gloss: to work off (a debt), to put in (hours)

meanings.en: to work off (a debt or favour), to pay back by working
to work (a shift or set time)

examples.text: Я тебе всё отработала на тех выборах.
examples.trans: I paid you back in full at that election.

перевернуть.gloss: to tip over, to turn over

meanings.en: to tip over, to overturn, to flip

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.
The cat tipped over the water bowl.

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it
